push.title: L 0-5 vs SydSwny FanClub | You: 6.6 (5th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 5th worst match performance of the season, PhogsToffees, at 6.6. Chin up, cleats on.

THE GOOD
+ 92% passing on 13 attempts, up from your usual 76%. That's the kind of passing coaches put on the whiteboard.
+ 1 key pass. You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after BellyTb1 walked off. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ 5 goals conceded: +0.1. You did the boring stuff well, and it showed.

THE BAD
- No shots. For next time: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running. Next match, nail it.
- On-ball actions 13, down from your usual 29. Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 2 and set up a relegation match. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. That's the kind of number that loses matches.
- We shipped 5 goals to SydSwny FanClub and lost by 5. A team result, and it needs a team answer.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 6.6. That's not who we are, and it can't be who we become.

Coach's drill: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: The grass isn't greener on the other side; it's greener where you water it.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 0-5 vs SydSwny FanClub | You: rage quit
push.body:
BellyTb1, everybody has a breaking point. Tonight we found yours, and we're gonna move it.

THE GOOD
+ Misplaced passes 0, down from your usual 6. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.

THE BAD
- Only 0 passes (down from your usual 18). Simple fix: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
- No tackles attempted. Next rep: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes. That's how good becomes great.
- Rating came in 0.8 below what your on-ball stats earned. Training homework: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press. Mind over matter.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 3. Let's sharpen this: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.
- Both you and buddskees dipped on on-ball involvement. Lean on each other: make triangles, 1-2 touch.

THE UGLY
! Rage quit: you left at 18', before the final whistle, and the team played a player short. That's your 2nd walk-off for us. Quitting a match is a habit, and I want this to be the last time we see it. Count to ten, then go win the next ball.

Skill builder: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

Keep believing. - Coach Lasso
